scientific_integrity: The formulas are proved for all prime powers; computations provide bounded independent checks and do not establish the infinite claim. Historical references are credited, and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only maximum nilpotency-index probabilities for brackets, not all Jordan types; exact all-dimensional proof supplemented by finite prime-field tests; incomplete access to some indexed full texts leaves residual publication-priority risk.
title: Exact parity-split maximum nilpotency law for random brackets of triangular radicals
